$description: Veles Productions design tokens. Source of truth: VELES-Brandbook_v0.pdf (Media Lab DAM, file 5477654). Digital extensions marked with $extensions.veles.source = 'operational'. Generated 2026-06-12 from Faza 0 audit.

black.$description: Foundational 1. Veles black — warm, reddish black (Brand 3.0, decision 2026-11-01; replaces brandbook #000000). Print CMYK not yet proofed: agree a rich-black recipe with the print house before first print run.

red.$description: Foundational 2. Signature accent. The ONLY allowed red.

grey.$description: Foundational 3. Light cool grey (rules, dividers, light panels).

panel.$description: Warm near-black. Panels, body text on white.

near-white.$description: Near-white. Tile/card backgrounds on white pages.

derived.$description: NO additional hex values are allowed. Derive shades ONLY via rgba() of the 7 palette colors, e.g. rgba(239,62,70,.55) for dimmed red, rgba(22,6,6,.55) for shadows. Decision 2026-06-12: #c8313a (legacy red-dim) is FORBIDDEN. Brand 3.0: #000000 left the palette.

brand.$description: Brand 3.0 (decisions 2026-11-01): Alliance No.2 is the brand font; Manrope (Google Fonts, OFL) is the official alternate wherever Alliance cannot go (Google Docs, slides, mail, quick team interfaces). Arial and BR Hendrix are withdrawn. Alliance No.2 licence scope (print, apps, embedding) is still open — brand/gaps.md G12.

title.$description: ExtraBold — all titles/headlines. Highest weight shared by Alliance No.2 and Manrope.

scale.$description: Operational scale (brandbook hierarchy pages are unfilled placeholders — gap G1 in brand/gaps.md). Proven in production decks. Print-oriented (pt); for web multiply pt by ~1.333 to px.

space.$description: Print page chrome (A4). Operational, derived from production decks.

logo-min-print.$description: Brandbook: minimal logo size in print is 10mm; keep >=10mm from page edge. Absolute floor for the mark, NOT the legibility threshold - see logo-min-legible.

logo-min-legible.$description: Operational minimum for OUR asset, used by templates for the page header. The lockup is VERTICAL (symbol above wordmark) and 'VELES' takes ~15% of its height, so height H yields a ~0.15*H wordmark: 11mm gave 1.6mm (illegible smear), 16mm gives 2.4mm (holds in print). Footers carry NO logo - a ~5mm mark breaks both this and logo-min-print. Revisit only once a horizontal lockup asset exists (brand/gaps.md G13).

logo-cover.$description: Cover logo height on A4. Web equivalent: 88px (see templates/_shared-webdoc.html).

logo.$description: Triangular 'V' symbol + spaced-caps VELES wordmark (NO trailing dot). Allowed color setups ONLY: red on Veles black (#160606), black-on-red, black-on-white. Files in assets/logo/.

tagline.$value: Shaping Digital Worlds for Human Future
tagline.$description: Official tagline (website; not present in Brandbook V1 — gap G2).

headline-style.$description: Brandbook headline device: big Black-weight headlines end with a period ('Our Brand.', 'Thank You.'). Applies to display headlines, NOT to the VELES wordmark.

runes.$description: Znaki Velesa (Brand 3.0, decyzje 2026-11-01/02): sześć znaków wartości (odwaga zastąpiła innowację) + amulet + sześć znaków funkcyjnych, konstrukcja głagolicy kątowej z tablicy z Baški, kreska 3 w siatce 60. Każdy znak wartości ma też wersję z pikseli 15x15 (pixel-*.svg, siatki w pixel-grids.json) — element graficzny marki. Doktryna: brand/runes.md.

motion.$description: CSS/web motion tokens dla self-contained dokumentów HTML (webdoc). Doktryna użycia, dozwolona lista czterech ruchów i zakazy: brand/motion-guidelines.md sekcja 'CSS/web'. Source: operational (Faza 2, spec 0044, 2026-07-21).

slow.$description: Reveal okładki/logo — jedna sekwencja przy załadowaniu.

pixel.$description: Znak z pikseli: przejście koloru jednego piksela.

pixel-step.$description: Opóźnienie kolejnego piksela: (wiersz*15+kolumna)*4ms — znak zapala się piksel po pikselu.

pixel-hold.$description: Czas pokazu jednego znaku, zanim przejdzie w następny (tylko hero strony / ekran startowy).

standard.$description: Ostry, kanciasty easing spójny z estetyką kątów 0/45/90. Domyślny dla reveal, wipe i paska postępu.

draw.$description: Łagodne wyhamowanie dla kreślenia run — 'znak domyka obwód'.

reduced-motion.$description: prefers-reduced-motion:reduce jest OBOWIĄZKOWY w każdym dokumencie z motion (brand/motion-guidelines.md §3) — nie opcja, błąd QA jeśli brak.
